text:
incident-bot: Pager - SEV2: High OOM/CUDA error rate on serving-pool-rack-7
oncall-ryan: paging in, grabbing it. what's impacted?
support-jen: acme-corp showing 502s and timeouts since 11:02 UTC, ~4% errors on prod route /generate
nina: seeing a spike in container restarts on nodes r7-0..r7-3. runtime.log shows repeated "CUDA out of memory" then kernel resets
nina: snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:01:58Z ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T11:02:01Z INFO container: restarting (exitcode=137)
```

dinesh: also noticing ib stats show retransmits on r7-1 rx_qp0: 12/sec, link counters growing
net-bot: IB QP stats: rx_dropped=1200, retrans=980, mtu_mismatch=0
infra-matt: can someone run `ibv_devinfo -v` and `ethtool -S ens785f0` on r7-1 and r7-2
sre-liz: running tcpdump on srv-r7-1 to confirm microbursts, collecting pcap to /tmp/pcap-r7-1.pcap
oncall-ryan: let's cordon r7-1 and drain, move traffic to spare-rack-4. Nina, can you trigger rollout to fallback-quantized-v2 model on the routing layer?
nina: starting rollout: `routes set /generate model=fallback-quantized-v2 weight=100 --force` (will stream)

deploy-bot: Rollout started by nina at 11:05 UTC, id=rl-7212
nina: also pushing kernel nic reset on r7-2: `sudo modprobe -r mlx5_core; sudo modprobe mlx5_core` (will be brief)
infra-matt: note: resetting mlx5 on production can drop in-flight requests, confirming with oncall
oncall-ryan: do it after we finish draining r7-1
sre-liz: drain of r7-1 in progress: `kubectl drain r7-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> pods migrating

net-bot: observed path changes: ECMP chose alternate route via spine-3 at 11:06 UTC, latency spiking to 6-8ms
dinesh: suspecting NIC offload interactions with large MTU+roce. let's temporarily set MTU to 1500 on r7-2 and r7-3
infra-matt: applied MTU=1500 on r7-2 and r7-3, restarting ib service
sre-liz: after MTU change, retransmits on r7-1 dropped from 12/sec to 1/sec in 30s, OOMs reduced
support-jen: acme-corp error rate dropped to 0.6%, customers reporting improvement :thumbsup:
oncall-ryan: holding traffic on fallback-quantized-v2 for 15m, will revert when stable
nina: capturing config diffs and adding to incident doc
oncall-ryan: severity update -> Sev2 (partial impact). Notified eng leads and sia
incident-bot: note created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3159129999
infra-matt: create follow-up ticket to test MTU/roce combos and schedule perf run
dinesh: postmortem owner? I can take it, will include reproducer script and perf matrix
sre-liz: schedule RCA sync at 15:30 UTC, invite net, infra, runtime teams
oncall-ryan: thanks everyone. I'll keep the channel open for 30m and then hand back to normal ops :eyes:
support-jen: I'll send customer note to acme-corp now: "we mitigated an infrastructure-induced serving degradation; full postmortem forthcoming"
